g.text: F4 | N and unit: 96 held-out site-days per rule; interval bars are the site-day bootstrap 95% interval. B2 is a
literature-adapted baseline; where it uses future information it is an offline upper bound, not an online-
executable rule. Same replayed stream within each site-day.
